thread:
Rae N: Heads-up: planned announce goes live next Thurs 09:00 PT. Need engineering to confirm the final changelog URL and docs screenshots by EOD today.
Ish K: Changelog draft: https://redwood.ai/changelog/v1.0-beta. Key bullets: streaming perf tweaks, prefix caching, Dedicated capacity updates.
Rae N: Marketing copy wants a short lead: 'Redwood v1.0 beta: lower-latency streaming and smarter caching.' Avoid absolutes about GA.
Hector M: Agreed. Also recommend we surface that the latency figures are a range and "preliminary internal benchmarks" with link to run: https://bench.redwood.ai/run/2142
Deploy Bot: Staged rollout scheduled: canary-eu1 at Thu 01:00 PT, canary-us1 at Thu 02:30 PT, gradual ramp to 50% by Thu 05:00 PT. Notify: #eng-oncall. Job: 99887.
Elle P: Webinar landing page is live at /events/v1-0-beta. Speakers: Ish (tech deep dive), Elle (product), Rae (customer stories). We'll capture utm_campaign=beta_launch and include fields: name, email, company, interest_area.
Rae N: For inbound lead routing, set webhook to https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-beta and tag source=webinar. Please include 'company_size' as optional field.
Hector M: Rollback owner: Hector. Runbook link: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-v1.0. Steps are minimal: revert to v0.9.2, run smoke, confirm latency within SLA.
Ish K: Note: a small subset of console screens are behind a flag until regional rollout completes. We'll publish a docs note calling that out.
Rae N: Press embargo: Thu 08:00 PT. Marketing posts at 09:00 PT. If docs or changelog aren't live by 16:00 PT, delay post and ping this thread.
Deploy Bot: Reminder: maintenance window in eu1 Thu 00:30 PT. Consider shifting canary if conflict.
Hector M: I'll move the canary to Thu 01:45 PT to avoid the window and update the release doc.
Rae N: Thanks — final checklist added to the launch doc. I'll post the announcement copy by 4pm PT for quick legal review. :white_check_mark:
